```{r Step 1: Setup and load required packages}
# Set knitting options for clean output
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = TRUE,    # show code
  message = FALSE,   # suppress messages
  warning = FALSE    # suppress warnings
)


# Load required packages and define input/output folders
library(tidyverse)
library(httr)
library(rvest)
library(git2r)
library(paperboy)
library(lubridate)
library(jsonlite)
library(purrr)

# Define output folders
step_1_working_data_output_folder <- "/Users/zorbeyozcan/newsmedia_scraper/working_data/link_scraper_output" # large files 
step_1_output_folder <- "/Users/zorbeyozcan/newsmedia_scraper/data" # in - and output files 
step_1_documentation_folder <- "/Users/zorbeyozcan/newsmedia_scraper/documentation" # documentation files 

# Check if folders exist and create if necessary
step_1_folder_check <- c(step_1_working_data_output_folder, 
                         step_1_output_folder, 
                         step_1_documentation_folder)

for(folder in step_1_folder_check){
  if(!dir.exists(folder)){
    dir.create(folder, recursive = TRUE)
  }
}

# Load link list 
step_1_link_list <- readRDS(file.path(step_1_output_folder, "all_links_filtered_by_date.rds")) 

# Load paywall domain input with sample articles
step_1_paywall_input <- read.csv2("/Users/zorbeyozcan/newsmedia_scraper/data/paywall_domains.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


# Verify data loaded correctly
step_1_links_loaded <- nrow(step_1_link_list)
step_1_paywall_domains_loaded <- length(unique(step_1_paywall_input$domain))

cat(sprintf("Step 1 completed: Packages loaded, output folders defined. Loaded %d links and %d paywall domains.\n", 
            step_1_links_loaded, 
            step_1_paywall_domains_loaded))

```


```{r Step 2: Extract and analyze paywall detection rules}
# Load paywall analysis data
step_2_paywall_input <- step_1_paywall_input

# Initialize list to collect all content data
step_2_all_content_data <- list()
step_2_row_counter <- 0

# Process all unique domains
step_2_unique_domains <- unique(step_2_paywall_input$domain)

for(domain in step_2_unique_domains) {
  # Get all rows for this domain
  step_2_domain_data <- step_2_paywall_input %>%
    filter(domain == !!domain)
  
  # Extract possible markers for this domain
  step_2_markers <- step_2_domain_data$possible_markers %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    unique() %>%
    paste(collapse = "/")
  
  # Check if domain has no paywall
  if(any(grepl("no_paywall", step_2_domain_data$paywall_url, ignore.case = TRUE))) {
    # Add placeholder rows for no-paywall domains
    for(i in 1:nrow(step_2_domain_data)) {
      step_2_row_counter <- step_2_row_counter + 1
      step_2_all_content_data[[step_2_row_counter]] <- list(
        domain = domain,
        paywall_url = "no_paywall",
        paywall_content = NA_character_,
        free_url = step_2_domain_data$free_url[i],
        free_content = NA_character_,
        possible_markers = step_2_markers
      )
    }
    next
  }
  
  # Process each row for domains with paywall
  for(i in 1:nrow(step_2_domain_data)) {
    # Initialize content variables
    paywall_content_result <- NA_character_
    free_content_result <- NA_character_
    
    # Fetch paywall content
    if(!is.na(step_2_domain_data$paywall_url[i])) {
      step_2_paywall_response <- tryCatch({
        httr::GET(step_2_domain_data$paywall_url[i],
                  httr::config(http_version = 0),
                  httr::add_headers("User-Agent" = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"),
                  httr::timeout(10))
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if(!is.null(step_2_paywall_response) && httr::status_code(step_2_paywall_response) == 200) {
        paywall_content_result <- httr::content(step_2_paywall_response, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
      }
    }
    
    # Fetch free content
    if(!is.na(step_2_domain_data$free_url[i])) {
      step_2_free_response <- tryCatch({
        httr::GET(step_2_domain_data$free_url[i],
                  httr::config(http_version = 0),
                  httr::add_headers("User-Agent" = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"),
                  httr::timeout(10))
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if(!is.null(step_2_free_response) && httr::status_code(step_2_free_response) == 200) {
        free_content_result <- httr::content(step_2_free_response, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
      }
    }
    
    # Store data in list
    step_2_row_counter <- step_2_row_counter + 1
    step_2_all_content_data[[step_2_row_counter]] <- list(
      domain = domain,
      paywall_url = step_2_domain_data$paywall_url[i],
      paywall_content = paywall_content_result,
      free_url = step_2_domain_data$free_url[i],
      free_content = free_content_result,
      possible_markers = step_2_markers
    )
  }
}

# Convert list to dataframe
step_2_content_df <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, step_2_all_content_data)
step_2_content_df$paywall_content <- as.character(step_2_content_df$paywall_content)
step_2_content_df$free_content <- as.character(step_2_content_df$free_content)

# Initialize paywall rules dataframe
step_2_paywall_rules_df <- data.frame(
  domain = character(),
  has_paywall = logical(),
  paywall_markers = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Define paywall keywords for detection
step_2_paywall_keywords <- c("paywall", "premium", "plus", "abo", "subscriber", "subscription", "metered")

# Analyze each domain
for(domain in unique(step_2_content_df$domain)) {
  # Get domain data
  step_2_domain_content <- step_2_content_df[step_2_content_df$domain == domain,]
  
  # Check if domain is free
  if(any(step_2_domain_content$paywall_url == "no_paywall")) {
    step_2_paywall_rules_df <- rbind(step_2_paywall_rules_df,
                                     data.frame(
                                       domain = domain,
                                       has_paywall = FALSE,
                                       paywall_markers = NA,
                                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE
                                     ))
    next
  }
  
  # Extract possible markers from CSV
  step_2_possible_markers <- unique(step_2_domain_content$possible_markers)[1]
  step_2_marker_list <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(step_2_possible_markers, "/")))
  step_2_marker_list <- step_2_marker_list[step_2_marker_list != ""]
  
  # Initialize tracking
  step_2_paywall_nodes <- list()
  step_2_free_nodes <- list()
  
  # Get contents
  step_2_paywall_contents <- step_2_domain_content$paywall_content[!is.na(step_2_domain_content$paywall_content)]
  step_2_free_contents <- step_2_domain_content$free_content[!is.na(step_2_domain_content$free_content)]
  
  # Create XPath for CSS/ID-based search
  xpath_query <- paste0("//*[",
                       paste(sapply(step_2_paywall_keywords, function(k) {
                         sprintf("contains(translate(@class,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'), '%s') or contains(translate(@id,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'), '%s')", 
                                k, k)
                       }), collapse = " or "),
                       "]")
  
  # Analyze paywall content
  for(i in seq_along(step_2_paywall_contents)) {
    if(!is.na(step_2_paywall_contents[i]) && nzchar(step_2_paywall_contents[i])) {
      html <- rvest::read_html(step_2_paywall_contents[i])
      
      # Search for elements with paywall keywords in class/id
      matching_elements <- tryCatch({
        html %>% rvest::html_elements(xpath = xpath_query)
      }, error = function(e) character(0))
      
      if(length(matching_elements) > 0) {
        for(elem in matching_elements) {
          tag_name <- rvest::html_name(elem)
          class_attr <- rvest::html_attr(elem, "class")
          id_attr <- rvest::html_attr(elem, "id")
          
          # Skip generic elements
          if(tag_name %in% c("svg", "path", "g", "script", "style")) next
          
          # Create node identifier
          node_id <- tag_name
          if(!is.na(id_attr) && any(sapply(step_2_paywall_keywords, function(k) grepl(k, tolower(id_attr))))) {
            node_id <- paste0(tag_name, "#", id_attr)
          } else if(!is.na(class_attr)) {
            classes <- unlist(strsplit(class_attr, " "))
            paywall_classes <- classes[grepl(paste(step_2_paywall_keywords, collapse = "|"), tolower(classes))]
            if(length(paywall_classes) > 0) {
              node_id <- paste0(tag_name, ".", paywall_classes[1])
            }
          }
          
          # Track occurrence
          if(i == 1) {
            step_2_paywall_nodes[[node_id]] <- 1
          } else {
            if(node_id %in% names(step_2_paywall_nodes)) {
              step_2_paywall_nodes[[node_id]] <- step_2_paywall_nodes[[node_id]] + 1
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      # Also search for text-based markers from CSV
      for(marker in step_2_marker_list) {
        if(marker == "") next
        xpath_text <- sprintf("//*[contains(text(), '%s')]", marker)
        text_elements <- tryCatch({
          html %>% rvest::html_elements(xpath = xpath_text)
        }, error = function(e) character(0))
        
        if(length(text_elements) > 0) {
          for(elem in text_elements) {
            tag_name <- rvest::html_name(elem)
            class_attr <- rvest::html_attr(elem, "class")
            id_attr <- rvest::html_attr(elem, "id")
            
            if(tag_name %in% c("svg", "path", "g", "script", "style")) next
            
            # Create simplified identifier
            node_id <- tag_name
            if(!is.na(id_attr) && nchar(id_attr) < 30) {
              node_id <- paste0(tag_name, "#", id_attr)
            } else if(!is.na(class_attr)) {
              classes <- unlist(strsplit(class_attr, " "))
              meaningful_classes <- classes[!grepl("^(w-|h-|m-|p-|text-|bg-|flex|grid)", classes)]
              if(length(meaningful_classes) > 0 && nchar(meaningful_classes[1]) < 30) {
                node_id <- paste0(tag_name, ".", meaningful_classes[1])
              }
            }
            
            if(i == 1) {
              step_2_paywall_nodes[[node_id]] <- 1
            } else {
              if(node_id %in% names(step_2_paywall_nodes)) {
                step_2_paywall_nodes[[node_id]] <- step_2_paywall_nodes[[node_id]] + 1
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Analyze free content
  for(content in step_2_free_contents) {
    if(!is.na(content) && nzchar(content)) {
      html <- rvest::read_html(content)
      
      # Search for paywall keyword elements
      matching_elements <- tryCatch({
        html %>% rvest::html_elements(xpath = xpath_query)
      }, error = function(e) character(0))
      
      if(length(matching_elements) > 0) {
        for(elem in matching_elements) {
          tag_name <- rvest::html_name(elem)
          class_attr <- rvest::html_attr(elem, "class")
          id_attr <- rvest::html_attr(elem, "id")
          
          if(tag_name %in% c("svg", "path", "g", "script", "style")) next
          
          node_id <- tag_name
          if(!is.na(id_attr) && any(sapply(step_2_paywall_keywords, function(k) grepl(k, tolower(id_attr))))) {
            node_id <- paste0(tag_name, "#", id_attr)
          } else if(!is.na(class_attr)) {
            classes <- unlist(strsplit(class_attr, " "))
            paywall_classes <- classes[grepl(paste(step_2_paywall_keywords, collapse = "|"), tolower(classes))]
            if(length(paywall_classes) > 0) {
              node_id <- paste0(tag_name, ".", paywall_classes[1])
            }
          }
          
          step_2_free_nodes[[node_id]] <- TRUE
        }
      }
      
      # Search for text markers
      for(marker in step_2_marker_list) {
        if(marker == "") next
        xpath_text <- sprintf("//*[contains(text(), '%s')]", marker)
        text_elements <- tryCatch({
          html %>% rvest::html_elements(xpath = xpath_text)
        }, error = function(e) character(0))
        
        if(length(text_elements) > 0) {
          for(elem in text_elements) {
            tag_name <- rvest::html_name(elem)
            class_attr <- rvest::html_attr(elem, "class")
            id_attr <- rvest::html_attr(elem, "id")
            
            if(tag_name %in% c("svg", "path", "g", "script", "style")) next
            
            node_id <- tag_name
            if(!is.na(id_attr) && nchar(id_attr) < 30) {
              node_id <- paste0(tag_name, "#", id_attr)
            } else if(!is.na(class_attr)) {
              classes <- unlist(strsplit(class_attr, " "))
              meaningful_classes <- classes[!grepl("^(w-|h-|m-|p-|text-|bg-|flex|grid)", classes)]
              if(length(meaningful_classes) > 0 && nchar(meaningful_classes[1]) < 30) {
                node_id <- paste0(tag_name, ".", meaningful_classes[1])
              }
            }
            
            step_2_free_nodes[[node_id]] <- TRUE
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Find definite markers
  step_2_definite_markers <- character()
  step_2_num_paywall_contents <- length(step_2_paywall_contents)
  
  for(node_id in names(step_2_paywall_nodes)) {
    if(step_2_paywall_nodes[[node_id]] == step_2_num_paywall_contents &&
       !(node_id %in% names(step_2_free_nodes))) {
      step_2_definite_markers <- c(step_2_definite_markers, node_id)
    }
  }
  
  # Add to results
  step_2_paywall_rules_df <- rbind(step_2_paywall_rules_df,
                                   data.frame(
                                     domain = domain,
                                     has_paywall = TRUE,
                                     paywall_markers = paste(step_2_definite_markers, collapse = "|"),
                                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE
                                   ))
}

# Save paywall rules for html search 
saveRDS(step_2_paywall_rules_df, 
        file.path(step_1_documentation_folder, "link_scraper_paywall_detection_rules.rds"))

# Log completion status
step_2_domains_processed <- nrow(step_2_paywall_rules_df)
step_2_no_paywall_domains <- sum(!step_2_paywall_rules_df$has_paywall, na.rm = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("Step 2 completed: Paywall detection rules extracted for %d domains. %d domains identified as paywall-free.\n",
            step_2_domains_processed,
            step_2_no_paywall_domains))
```

```{r Step 3: Extract parser rules from paperboy repository}
# Extract and clean unique domains from link list
step_3_unique_domains <- step_2_unique_domains

# Initialize dataframe to store parser rules
step_3_parser_rules_df <- data.frame(
  domain = character(),
  uses_json = logical(),
  datetime_rule = character(),
  headline_rule = character(),
  author_rule = character(),
  text_rule = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Function to transform domain to GitHub filename
step_3_domain_to_filename_func <- function(domain) {
  # Special cases
  if(domain == "augsburger-allgemeine.de") {
    return("deliver_augsburger_allgemeine.R")
  }
  if(domain == "n-tv.de") {
    return("deliver_n-tv_de.R")
  }
  
  # Default transformation: Replace dots and hyphens with underscores and add prefix/suffix
  filename <- gsub("\\.", "_", domain)
  filename <- gsub("-", "_", filename)
  return(paste0("deliver_", filename, ".R"))
}

# Function to extract parsing rules from R script content
step_3_extract_rules_func <- function(script_content, domain) {
  # Check if script uses JSON parsing
  step_3_uses_json <- grepl("jsonlite::fromJSON", script_content, fixed = TRUE)
  
  # Extract datetime rule
  step_3_datetime_pattern <- "datetime <- ([^\\n]+(?:\\n\\s+[^\\n]+)*?)(?=\\n\\s*[a-zA-Z_]+ <-|\\n\\s*s_n_list)"
  step_3_datetime_match <- regmatches(script_content, regexec(step_3_datetime_pattern, script_content, perl = TRUE))
  step_3_datetime_rule <- ifelse(length(step_3_datetime_match[[1]]) > 1, 
                                 trimws(step_3_datetime_match[[1]][2]), 
                                 NA)
  
  # Extract headline rule
  step_3_headline_pattern <- "headline <- ([^\\n]+(?:\\n\\s+[^\\n]+)*?)(?=\\n\\s*[a-zA-Z_]+ <-|\\n\\s*s_n_list)"
  step_3_headline_match <- regmatches(script_content, regexec(step_3_headline_pattern, script_content, perl = TRUE))
  step_3_headline_rule <- ifelse(length(step_3_headline_match[[1]]) > 1, 
                                 trimws(step_3_headline_match[[1]][2]), 
                                 NA)
  
  # Extract author rule
  step_3_author_pattern <- "author <- ([^\\n]+(?:\\n\\s+[^\\n]+)*?)(?=\\n\\s*[a-zA-Z_]+ <-|\\n\\s*s_n_list)"
  step_3_author_match <- regmatches(script_content, regexec(step_3_author_pattern, script_content, perl = TRUE))
  step_3_author_rule <- ifelse(length(step_3_author_match[[1]]) > 1, 
                               trimws(step_3_author_match[[1]][2]), 
                               NA)
  
  # Extract text rule
  step_3_text_pattern <- "text <- ([^\\n]+(?:\\n\\s+[^\\n]+)*?)(?=\\n\\s*s_n_list)"
  step_3_text_match <- regmatches(script_content, regexec(step_3_text_pattern, script_content, perl = TRUE))
  step_3_text_rule <- ifelse(length(step_3_text_match[[1]]) > 1, 
                             trimws(step_3_text_match[[1]][2]), 
                             NA)
  
  # Return extracted rules as data frame row
  return(data.frame(
    domain = domain,
    uses_json = step_3_uses_json,
    datetime_rule = step_3_datetime_rule,
    headline_rule = step_3_headline_rule,
    author_rule = step_3_author_rule,
    text_rule = step_3_text_rule,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
}

# Process each domain
step_3_processed_count <- 0
step_3_json_count <- 0
step_3_failed_count <- 0

for(domain in step_3_unique_domains) {
  # Generate filename for this domain
  step_3_filename <- step_3_domain_to_filename_func(domain)
  
  # Construct GitHub raw URL
  step_3_github_url <- paste0("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JBGruber/paperboy/main/R/", 
                              step_3_filename)

  # Download R script from GitHub
  step_3_response <- httr::GET(step_3_github_url)
  
  # Check if request was successful
  if(httr::status_code(step_3_response) == 200) {
    # Extract content as text
    step_3_script_content <- httr::content(step_3_response, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
    
    # Extract parsing rules
    step_3_domain_rules <- step_3_extract_rules_func(step_3_script_content, domain)
    
    # Add to main dataframe
    step_3_parser_rules_df <- rbind(step_3_parser_rules_df, step_3_domain_rules)
    
    # Update counters
    step_3_processed_count <- step_3_processed_count + 1
    if(step_3_domain_rules$uses_json) {
      step_3_json_count <- step_3_json_count + 1
    }
    
  } else {
    # Log error but continue
    cat(sprintf("Failed to download parser for domain: %s (HTTP %d) - URL: %s\n", 
                domain, 
                httr::status_code(step_3_response),
                step_3_github_url))
    step_3_failed_count <- step_3_failed_count + 1
  }
}

# Save parser rules for html function
saveRDS(step_3_parser_rules_df, 
        file.path(step_1_documentation_folder, "link_scraper_parser_rules.rds"))


# Log completion status
cat(sprintf("\nStep 3 completed: Extracted parser rules for %d domains. %d domains use JSON parsing, %d use HTML parsing.\n",
            step_3_processed_count,
            step_3_json_count,
            step_3_processed_count - step_3_json_count))
cat(sprintf("Failed to process %d domains.\n", step_3_failed_count))

```

```{r Step 4: Define parser module function}
# Load required parser rules and paywall rules
step_4_parser_rules <- readRDS(file.path(step_1_documentation_folder, "link_scraper_parser_rules.rds"))
step_4_paywall_rules <- readRDS(file.path(step_1_documentation_folder, "link_scraper_paywall_detection_rules.rds"))


# Main parser function
step_4_parse_article_func <- function(html_content, url, domain) {
  
  # Initialize output with default values
  step_4_output <- data.frame(
    domain = domain,
    url = url,
    fetch_timestamp = as.numeric(Sys.time()),
    datetime = NA,
    author = NA,
    headline = NA,
    text = NA,
    paywall_flag = NA,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Get parser rules for this domain
  step_4_domain_rules <- step_4_parser_rules %>%
    filter(domain == !!domain)
  
  # Check if parser rules exist for domain
  if(nrow(step_4_domain_rules) == 0) {
    warning(sprintf("No parser rules found for domain: %s", domain))
    return(step_4_output)
  }
  
  # Parse HTML content
  html <- tryCatch({
    rvest::read_html(html_content)
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(sprintf("Failed to parse HTML for URL: %s - %s", url, e$message))
    return(step_4_output)
  })
  
  # Check if domain uses JSON parsing
  if(step_4_domain_rules$uses_json[1]) {
    
    # Extract JSON-LD data
    json_txt <- html %>%
      rvest::html_elements("script[type = \"application/ld+json\"]") %>%
      rvest::html_text()
    
    if(length(json_txt) > 0 && !is.na(json_txt[1])) {
      # Parse JSON
      json_df <- tryCatch({
        jsonlite::fromJSON(json_txt[1])
      }, error = function(e) {
        warning(sprintf("Failed to parse JSON for URL: %s", url))
        NULL
      })
      
      if(!is.null(json_df)) {
        # Apply JSON-based rules
        
        # Extract datetime
        if(!is.na(step_4_domain_rules$datetime_rule[1])) {
          step_4_output$datetime <- tryCatch({
            eval(parse(text = step_4_domain_rules$datetime_rule[1]))
          }, error = function(e) NA)
        }
        
        # Extract headline
        if(!is.na(step_4_domain_rules$headline_rule[1])) {
          step_4_output$headline <- tryCatch({
            eval(parse(text = step_4_domain_rules$headline_rule[1]))
          }, error = function(e) NA)
        }
        
        # Extract author
        if(!is.na(step_4_domain_rules$author_rule[1])) {
          step_4_output$author <- tryCatch({
            eval(parse(text = step_4_domain_rules$author_rule[1]))
          }, error = function(e) NA)
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Text extraction (usually from HTML even for JSON sites)
    if(!is.na(step_4_domain_rules$text_rule[1])) {
      step_4_output$text <- tryCatch({
        eval(parse(text = step_4_domain_rules$text_rule[1]))
      }, error = function(e) NA)
    }
    
  } else {
    # HTML-based parsing
    
    # Extract datetime
    if(!is.na(step_4_domain_rules$datetime_rule[1])) {
      step_4_output$datetime <- tryCatch({
        # First try direct datetime extraction for common patterns
        datetime <- html %>%
          rvest::html_elements("time") %>%
          rvest::html_attr("datetime") %>%
          head(1) %>%
          lubridate::as_datetime()
        
        # If that fails, try the stored rule
        if(is.na(datetime)) {
          eval(parse(text = step_4_domain_rules$datetime_rule[1]))
        } else {
          datetime
        }
      }, error = function(e) NA)
    }
    
    # Extract headline
    if(!is.na(step_4_domain_rules$headline_rule[1])) {
      step_4_output$headline <- tryCatch({
        eval(parse(text = step_4_domain_rules$headline_rule[1]))
      }, error = function(e) NA)
    }
    
    # Extract author
    if(!is.na(step_4_domain_rules$author_rule[1])) {
      step_4_output$author <- tryCatch({
        eval(parse(text = step_4_domain_rules$author_rule[1]))
      }, error = function(e) NA)
    }
    
    # Extract text
    if(!is.na(step_4_domain_rules$text_rule[1])) {
      step_4_output$text <- tryCatch({
        eval(parse(text = step_4_domain_rules$text_rule[1]))
      }, error = function(e) NA)
    }
  }
  
  # Apply paywall detection
  step_4_paywall_rule <- step_4_paywall_rules %>%
    filter(domain == !!domain)
  
  if(nrow(step_4_paywall_rule) > 0) {
    if(!step_4_paywall_rule$has_paywall[1]) {
      # Domain has no paywall
      step_4_output$paywall_flag <- FALSE
    } else if(!is.na(step_4_paywall_rule$paywall_markers[1]) && step_4_paywall_rule$paywall_markers[1] != "") {
      # Check for paywall markers in HTML
      step_4_markers <- unlist(strsplit(step_4_paywall_rule$paywall_markers[1], "\\|"))
      step_4_marker_found <- FALSE
      
      for(marker in step_4_markers) {
        # Parse marker format (e.g., "div#paywall-container" or "div.paywall-class")
        if(grepl("#", marker)) {
          # ID-based marker
          parts <- strsplit(marker, "#")[[1]]
          tag <- parts[1]
          id <- parts[2]
          
          # Search for element with this ID
          elements <- html %>%
            rvest::html_elements(sprintf("%s#%s", tag, id))
          
          if(length(elements) > 0) {
            step_4_marker_found <- TRUE
            break
          }
        } else if(grepl("\\.", marker)) {
          # Class-based marker
          parts <- strsplit(marker, "\\.")[[1]]
          tag <- parts[1]
          class <- parts[2]
          
          # Search for element with this class
          elements <- html %>%
            rvest::html_elements(sprintf("%s.%s", tag, class))
          
          if(length(elements) > 0) {
            step_4_marker_found <- TRUE
            break
          }
        } else {
          # Tag-only marker
          elements <- html %>%
            rvest::html_elements(marker)
          
          if(length(elements) > 0) {
            step_4_marker_found <- TRUE
            break
          }
        }
      }
      
      step_4_output$paywall_flag <- step_4_marker_found
    } else {
      # No markers defined but domain has paywall
      step_4_output$paywall_flag <- FALSE
    }
  } else {
    # Domain not in paywall rules
    step_4_output$paywall_flag <- NA
  }
  
  # Convert datetime to character for consistent storage
  if(!is.na(step_4_output$datetime)) {
    step_4_output$datetime <- as.character(step_4_output$datetime)
  }
  
  return(step_4_output)
}

# Log module completion
cat(sprintf("Step 4 completed: Parser module defined. Function 'step_4_parse_article_func' ready for use.\n"))
```
